title: Enabled switch and loaded rules reported active filtering without a tunnel
reproduction: On the signed API30 baseline remove the last validated network with protection on and a checked source; inspect Home and reopen it.
expected: Keep the user's on setting; say waiting for network until the service and Android report an established tunnel and blocking rules are loaded.
observed: Home stayed Protection active on Wi-Fi loss and LTE loss even after Android removed the VPN agent and its local alias.
fix: Consume the existing visible Home observer's established-tunnel result and the service waiting phase; render these separately from the switch and count.

Signed 34765cb4 OTA: checked waiting on Wi-Fi and LTE loss, active on both recoveries, correct direct DNS and Chrome. See deep-signoff/vpn-network-recovery.md.

title: Foreground card retained active title during network loss
reproduction: With the signed API30 VPN active remove the final validated network; inspect the actual Android notification shade.
expected: Replace the active foreground title with waiting; retain pause and the requested service; return to active after reconnection.
observed: Foreground notification ID 20 still read Ad-blocker VPN active with Pause and no waiting card. Reproduced from Wi-Fi and LTE.
fix: Render non-stopped service phases on the foreground notification ID; keep waiting/reconnecting pausable and reserve the separate resume card for stopped.
